description:
FOUND s492c (Opus, 2026-09-21) after #2000 made `use FileHandle` load.

    use IPC::Cmd qw(can_run run);

    perl: loads
    PCL:  Parser2 TODO: lexical 'pn' possibly captured by nested sub
          _evaluate_version_line
          ... Failed to transpile .../Module/Metadata.pm

That is the capture-refusal family (#296 and its neighbours), in core
Module/Metadata.pm, reached through IPC::Cmd -> Module::Load::Conditional ->
Module::Metadata.  IPC::Cmd itself now gets past FileHandle.

The reproducer is the module file; the minimal shape is the usual one -- a
file-level `my` that a named sub's nested sub reads.  Worth measuring against
the current refusal set before assuming it is the same case.
subject: `use IPC::Cmd` still fails after #2000: Module::Metadata hits a Parser2 refusal ("lexical `pn` possibly captured by nested sub _evaluate_version_line")
